test_chart_coverage_pct.method: All four EIZO corner fiducials and the outer checkerboard are visible in the latest previews.

active_panel_roi_from_uniformity_25.method: Largest connected component above 5% of central green-plane level in the Uniformity 25 capture.

no_scene_beyond_active_screen.evidence: The full panel is contained in both fields, with dark-room background around it; subsequent uniformity analysis crops to active_panel_roi_from_uniformity_25.

cam0_to_cam1_relative_alignment.method: SIFT feature matching + RANSAC affine partial transform

limitations: The physical bezel is outside the field, so percentage of physical panel area cannot be measured.
The physical active-panel boundary cannot be measured from the EIZO chart because its surrounding field is black.
The affine displacement is expected from the side-by-side baseline and near monitor distance; it is not an image-quality failure.
The measured rotation includes relative camera orientation and panel perspective.
r5_status: PASS: the full active panel and all four EIZO fiducials are contained in both camera views; dark background is present and excluded using the measured panel ROI.
